visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a beige fabric bassinet liner. A man's hand enters from the right side of the frame, pointing directly at the white plastic frame of a stroller where the brand name "GREENTOM" is embossed in clearly raised white letters. The setting is outdoors at night, with warm artificial lighting from nearby street lamps casting soft shadows on the pavement. (2) A man wearing white thick-rimmed glasses, a black zip-up jacket over a graphic t-shirt, and khaki pants is shown carrying a white stroller frame over his right shoulder. He sets the frame down on the grey brick pavement and demonstrates unfolding a navy blue stroller seat, pointing out specific features with his fingers while maintaining a cheerful expression toward the camera. (3) The camera focuses on a black travel bag and various stroller compartments laid out on the ground. A hand points to a metallic handle bar, specifically showing a section of the black synthetic grip that is visibly peeling away and worn. The lighting remains low-key, highlighting the textures of the worn materials and the metallic sheen of the stroller parts. (4) The scene shifts to show two different baby bassinets placed side-by-side on the sidewalk. One model is light grey with a mesh fabric side, prominently displaying the "TUTTI bambini" brand logo on its grey plastic support leg. A hand touches the mesh fabric to demonstrate its flexibility and texture, while a dark van and urban buildings are visible in the background. (5) The final segment shows three men standing together on the sidewalk at night next to a dark van. They are engaged in an animated group discussion, with the main character in glasses gesturing widely and laughing. The others are smiling and listening, with city lights and distant street elements providing a busy urban backdrop in the shallow depth of field.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A primary male voice opens with a warm, casual greeting in Mandarin, explaining his intention to pass down baby strollers and bassinets. A mid-tempo acoustic pop BGM with bright guitar strums provides a cheerful backdrop. The recording is clear, with only very subtle ambient noise from the outdoor setting. (2) As the speaker demonstrates the stroller frame, a sharp "whoosh" sound effect marks the quick visual movement. The clicking of plastic joints and the soft rustle of fabric are audible as the stroller unfolds. The speaker's vocal arousal increases slightly to convey excitement and enthusiasm for the product quality. (3) The speaker details a used stroller bag, his voice taking on an informative and honest tone while describing the peeling handle. The BGM maintains a steady rhythmic pulse. Incidental tactile sounds of fingers rubbing against textured surfaces add a layer of realism to the acoustic environment. (4) A soft "ding" sound effect emphasizes a point about the bassinet's design. The primary vocal remains the central focus, delivered with clear articulation and rising intonations. The background music remains consistent in volume, sitting comfortably below the speech without causing spectral masking or interference. (5) The final phase introduces a layered soundscape of three men talking and laughing simultaneously. The BGM feels more vibrant as the group banter peaks. Short cartoonish sound effects are used to highlight humorous moments in the conversation, creating a dynamic and socially-dense audio experience.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog and product showcase where the creator reviews various baby strollers and bassinets he has used, detailing their pros and cons before giving them away to a colleague. The intent is to provide practical advice for parents while maintaining an entertaining, social atmosphere through group interaction at the end.
